Keep your work safe

  1. Create a folder on your PC called CORKBORK. Documents is a good place for it.
  2. Choose that folder below. It becomes the one master archive for original files and the workspace catalogue.
  3. Save a copy packages the catalogue and files together. To use the same workspace on other devices, connect Google Drive in Settings.
  1. This browser cannot use a folder on your device. iPad and iPhone browsers never can.
  2. Your boards and files are saved in this browser instead.
  3. Connect Google Drive in Settings to share one workspace with your other devices. Save a copy also makes a backup.
Your workspace also saves automatically in this browser.

Make CORKBORK fit you

Each theme remembers its own edits when you switch. Reset affects only the selected theme.
What changed, newest first. Kept terse on purpose — this file carries its own history, so verbosity costs file size.
Short guides you can reopen at any time.
Google Drive becomes the master copy shared by all your devices: PC, laptop, iPad and phone. Boards, notes and original files sync to a CORKBORK folder in your Drive. CORKBORK can only reach the files it creates there, never the rest of your Drive. Edits made on two devices are merged. If the same card was changed on both, the newer edit wins and the other is kept as a conflict copy. On iPad and phone, original files download when you open them. Privacy · Terms
Private boards (right-click a board → Make private) never leave the device they were made private on, and anything already uploaded from them is deleted from Drive. Other devices see a locked placeholder. Encrypted syncing of private boards comes later.
How do I get a Client ID?
Google requires the app to be identified before it will hand over access to your Drive. It is free and takes a few minutes, once.
  1. Open console.cloud.google.com and create a project.
  2. Under APIs & Services → Library, enable Google Drive API.
  3. Under OAuth consent screen, choose External, fill in a name and your own email, and add yourself under Test users.
  4. Under Credentials → Create credentials → OAuth client ID, pick Web application.
  5. Add your serving address (for example https://YOUR-NAME.github.io or http://localhost:8080) under Authorised JavaScript origins.
  6. Copy the Client ID it gives you and paste it below.
Use your own Google Client ID (advanced)
Archive folder. Set this up once. This is your master archive. It stores your original files and the workspace data needed to rebuild your boards. Keep the entire folder together. CORKBORK cannot access anything outside it.
Not available in this browser. Archive folders work in Chrome or Edge on a computer. iPad and iPhone browsers cannot use folders, so here your files are kept in this browser's storage. Use “Save a copy” below for a backup.
Version history. A snapshot of the whole workspace is kept every few minutes, and the newest 10 are retained. Large attachments are shared between snapshots instead of copied into each one. Restoring keeps the current version as a snapshot too, so restoring is itself undoable.
Your boards are saved automatically in this browser as a fast working cache. The selected archive folder is the durable master. “Back up now” adds a local restore point. “Save a copy” packages the catalogue and its files together; very large archives are copied directly to another folder instead.

New image imports retain their original bytes in the master archive while CORKBORK keeps a smaller viewing preview.
The saved workspace lives in the browser, not in the HTML file — every corkboard file opened from this computer shares the same boards. That is why a newly downloaded build opens with your existing boards instead of empty. To test a build against a truly blank workspace:
